data_fields.name: no_proxy_credit
data_fields.donor_constant: quest flag bit 0x00004000 (rule: MONSTER objective with no victim is skipped)

data_fields.name: sequenced_objective
data_fields.donor_constant: objective flag bit 0x0002 (counts after earlier objectives)

best_idea: One index from a target id to every active objective that counts it, credited exactly once per server kill, clamped to the target, and ignored once finished, with the quest completing only when every required objective is done.
decision_why: The fan-out index, the clamp and the finished-skip are the shape Frankendom needs for zone contracts on one ledger with server-verified kills; drop the WoW raid, proxy and quest-log-slot parts unless zones need them, and write Frankendom's own attacker-credit rule.
acceptance: In a zone contract 'clear 3 boars' the tracker reads 2/3 after the second boar dies and the contract completes on the server at the third kill; a fourth boar kill leaves it at 3/3 (a server test asserts progress never passes the target and a finished objective takes no more credit).
